name: AEO Bob Lite
author: Master22

sections.description:
AEO Bob Lite brings Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) to WordPress – completely free! As AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity become primary information sources, traditional SEO alone isn’t enough. AEO Bob Lite helps you optimize for both search engines AND AI systems.

Why AEO Matters

  • 100+ million daily users rely on AI assistants for answers
  • AI recommendations are replacing traditional search results
  • Content not optimized for AI becomes invisible to millions
  • Dual optimization needed: Google rankings AND AI discoverability

Features

Free AEO & SEO Scoring
* Instant AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) scores
* Traditional SEO scoring with detailed breakdowns
* Real-time analysis as you edit

Actionable Hints
* Clear improvement recommendations
* Question-answer format suggestions
* Structure optimization tips

Post List Integration
* See AEO & SEO scores in post/page lists
* Sortable columns with color-coded badges
* Quick identification of content needing work

Editor Support
* Works with Classic Editor, Block Editor (Gutenberg), and Elementor
* Scores visible while editing
* One-click content analysis
* Improvement hints in sidebar

100% Free Core Features
* No API keys required for basic analysis
* All core analysis done locally
* No usage limits on scoring

How It Works

  1. Install AEO Bob Lite
  2. Edit any post or page
  3. Click “Analyze Content” in the sidebar
  4. Review your AEO & SEO scores plus hints
  5. Optimize based on recommendations

What Gets Analyzed

AEO Score (0-100): Question-answer format, direct answers, content structure, readability, entity coverage, snippet-friendly formatting

SEO Score (0-100): Title optimization, meta description, keyword usage, heading structure, content length, internal/external links

Want More?

Upgrade to AEO Bob Pro for AI-powered suggestions, one-click apply, voice preservation, analytics, and bulk operations. Learn more

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0+
  • PHP 7.4+

External Services

This plugin optionally connects to OpenAI when you use AI-powered suggestion features. The core ANALYZE feature (AEO/SEO scoring) works 100% locally with no external calls.

OpenAI API

Endpoint: https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions
Used for: Generating AI-powered content suggestions and author voice analysis.
Data sent: Post title and content text only. No personal data is transmitted.
When sent: Only when you click “Analyze Voice” or “Get AI Suggestions” — never automatically.
Requires: Your own OpenAI API key, entered in AEO Bob → Settings. The plugin developer never receives or stores your key.
Terms: https://openai.com/terms
Privacy: https://openai.com/privacy

Anthropic API (Claude)

Endpoint: https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages
Used for: Optional AI-powered SEO suggestions (available only when AEO Bob Pro is installed; Lite does not call this).
Data sent: Content analysis summary (word count, headings, keyword density, etc.) — only when user requests SEO suggestions and Pro is active.
When sent: Only on explicit user action when Pro is installed and configured.
Requires: User’s own Anthropic API key (Pro only).
Terms: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/consumer-terms
Privacy: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy

Google Gemini API

Endpoint: https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1/models/…
Used for: Optional AI-powered SEO suggestions (available only when AEO Bob Pro is installed; Lite does not call this).
Data sent: Content analysis summary — only when user requests SEO suggestions and Pro is active.
When sent: Only on explicit user action when Pro is installed and configured.
Requires: User’s own Google API key (Pro only).
Terms: https://ai.google.dev/terms
Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Perplexity API

Endpoint: https://api.perplexity.ai/chat/completions
Used for: Optional AI-powered SEO suggestions (available only when AEO Bob Pro is installed; Lite does not call this).
Data sent: Content analysis summary — only when user requests SEO suggestions and Pro is active.
When sent: Only on explicit user action when Pro is installed and configured.
Requires: User’s own Perplexity API key (Pro only).
Terms: https://www.perplexity.ai/site/terms
Privacy: https://www.perplexity.ai/site/privacy

Cohere API

Endpoint: https://api.cohere.ai/v1/chat
Used for: Optional AI-powered SEO suggestions (available only when AEO Bob Pro is installed; Lite does not call this).
Data sent: Content analysis summary — only when user requests SEO suggestions and Pro is active.
When sent: Only on explicit user action when Pro is installed and configured.
Requires: User’s own Cohere API key (Pro only).
Terms: https://cohere.com/terms-of-use
Privacy: https://cohere.com/privacy

Summary

  • AEO Bob Lite calls only the OpenAI API. Anthropic, Google Gemini, Perplexity, and Cohere are documented above because their code paths exist in shared files; Lite never invokes them. AEO Bob Pro (separate plugin) enables those providers when installed.
  • Data is NEVER sent automatically — only on explicit user action
  • Only post title and content text are transmitted — never passwords, emails, or personal data
  • You must provide and manage your own OpenAI API key
  • The ANALYZE feature (AEO/SEO scoring) works entirely locally with zero external connections

Privacy Policy

AEO Bob Lite performs all AEO/SEO scoring locally on your WordPress server — no external connections are made for the free analysis features. When you optionally use the AI suggestion features (Analyze Voice, Get AI Suggestions), your post title and content text are sent to the OpenAI API using your own API key. No personal user data is collected or transmitted by the plugin. The plugin developer (AEO Bob / Master22 Solutions) never receives your content or API key. See the External Services section for full details.

Credits

Developed by the AEO Bob Team
Website: https://aeobob.com
Support: https://aeobob.com/support/
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for “AEO Bob Lite”
  3. Click “Install Now” then “Activate”
  4. That’s it! The plugin includes all necessary components.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  4. Activate the plugin
  5. All necessary components are bundled – no additional downloads needed

Getting Started

  1. After activation, go to AEO Bob in your WordPress admin menu
  2. Read the “How to Use” guide on the dashboard
  3. Edit any post or page
  4. Find the “AEO Bob – Content Analysis” meta box in the sidebar
  5. Click “Analyze Content” to get your scores
  6. Review the improvement hints and optimize your content
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key?

No! AEO Bob Lite is completely free and doesn’t require any API keys. All analysis is done locally on your WordPress site.

What’s the difference between Lite and Pro?

Lite (Free):
* AEO & SEO scoring (unlimited)
* Improvement hints
* Post list integration
* AI-powered suggestions via your own OpenAI API key
* One-click apply (unlimited)
* 100% free, no usage limits

Pro (Paid — separate plugin at aeobob.com):
* Everything in Lite, plus:
* Multiple AI providers: OpenAI, Anthropic (Claude), Google Gemini, Perplexity, DeepSeek
* More AI suggestions per post (6–10 vs 3 in Lite)
* Author voice AI — deep style matching
* Bulk operations — optimize multiple posts at once
* Advanced analytics and trend tracking
* Priority support

Compare plans

Does this work with Gutenberg?

Yes! AEO Bob Lite works with both the Gutenberg (Block Editor) and Classic Editor.

Will this slow down my site?

No. AEO Bob Lite only runs when you click the “Analyze” button. It doesn’t affect your frontend performance or page load times.

Can I use this with other SEO plugins?

Absolutely! AEO Bob Lite works alongside Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, and other SEO plugins.

What is AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)?

AEO is optimization for AI search engines and assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Gemini. It focuses on making your content easy for AI systems to understand, cite, and recommend.

Where can I get support?

  • Free users: WordPress.org Support Forum
  • Pro users: Priority support at aeobob.com/support
